Akane (better known as Jubei Yagyu) is a character from the Hyakka Ryōran: Samurai Girls series. She is a master samurai contracted under Muneakira.

  • 1 Appearance
  • 2 Personality
  • 3 Abilities
  • 4 Trivia
  • 5 Gallery
  • 6 Freetalks

Appearance[]

Akane has a detailed hairpin and a sword guard in her hair. She wears a pink sweater-dress with red trim and a white drawstring. On her back, she carries a Japanese drum with a long white cord attached; the end of the cord forms what appears to be a brush with a black holder marked with lettering, possibly representing the Yagyu surname. On her legs, she wears white tied cloths around her upper thighs, along with brown shin guards and black sandals.

Personality[]

Akane is an honorable warrior who shows respect to those she considers worthy. She is innocent, cheerful, forgetful, and somewhat childlike, often addressing others by nicknames. When she transforms, however, her personality changes drastically, becoming violent and sadistic.

Abilities[]

She wields both a katana and a wakizashi, with the katana capable of detaching into smaller blades. By kissing her contractor Muneakira, she can heighten her power level and become significantly stronger than in her regular state.

Trivia[]

  • She shares her name with the legendary samurai Yagyū Jūbē Mitsuyoshi.
